title: If
text: Select subsystem execution using logic similar to if-else statement, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough; {Number of inputs} sets the number of input ports, {Show else condition} controls display of else port, {Enable zero-crossing detection} controls zero-crossing detection, {Provide if-else statements in generated code} sets the option to include only if-else statements in code generated from If, {if} sets the logical expression u1 > and {elseif} sets the logical expression. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Logical operands
ports.summary: Values for evaluating logical expressions scalar | vector

ports.name: Action
ports.summary: Action signal for an If Action Subsystem block scalar

params.name: Number of inputs
params.values: Specify number of input ports 1 (default) | integer

params.name: Show else condition
params.values: Control display of else port on (default) | off

params.name: Provide if-else statements in generated code
params.values: Option to include only if-else statements in code generated from If block off (default) | on

params.name: elseif
params.values: Logical expression empty (default) | list of logical expressions
